name: DeltaHealth
tagline: Preliminary symptom guidance and a disease catalogue while you wait for medical care.

awards: [MLH] Best Domain Name from GoDaddy Registry

problem: Long healthcare wait times in Canada leave people anxious and uninformed.
solution: Symptom analysis with ML and an LLM, emergency contacts and a catalogue of conditions and treatments.
demo_moment: Team-described: enter symptoms and get preliminary advice.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Domain Name from GoDaddy Registry” among 134 submissions.
Positions itself between symptom onset and a doctor.

lessons: Health advice tools need explicit limits to stay credible.
